selection: every original suffix from all 64 source cases; retain both games, exact/range-mass encodings, full once/external all original seeds, signed/clipped regrets and uniform/linear averages under the original linear regret weights
zero_mass: exact row sum of archived final cumulative mass minus the archived left-boundary mass equals zero; no epsilon or near-zero selection
intervention: copy the same source case's whole-average OWN probabilities only into zero-window-mass rows owned by the designated target(s); every positive-mass row and all unselected rows stay bit-exact; preserve legal menus and original information groups
fixed_opponents: all four original saved whole-average opponent modes in the same game/encoding/traversal/seed group; both responding seats; replace only the responding seat, so fill_both equals its target-only fill in this match
full_control_gate: full suffix fills preserve both players' own realization reaches within 1e-12 and own exact/within/extra scores plus EV within 1e-9 chips; zero-mass rows should be unreachable under a consistent perfect-recall full average; any failure stops completion for diagnosis rather than changing tolerance or dropping a case
accounting: raw suffix policy/score controls reproduce the original archive; exact/within/extra self metrics obey the complete 2x2 seat-fill additive identity at 1e-9 chips; fixed-opponent roots stay constant and gain changes equal negative target EV changes; baseline EV interaction is retained separately, not required to be zero
tests: hand-calculated asymmetric hidden-action fixtures distinguish reachable unsampled zero-mass rows from structurally unreachable ones; both target signs, all fill masks, unchanged-row bytes, zero/no/all eligible rows, mass/window reconstruction, full realization equivalence, root/additivity identities, complete source grids, corrupted/partial/rehashed archives and retained failures; new Holdem training and reference strategy export blocked

admission: publish this protocol/config before implementation or intervention outcomes; meaningful math/loader/schema/failure tests, complete relevant base and optional checks and both hosted code CI jobs before measurement; clean source/config/archive bindings; own publication before independent comparison
publication: retain every complete/partial outcome without overwriting; fresh reproduction may use immutable ignored own staging before native comparison; original trajectory sources, data, seeds, gates and 7200/900s caps remain unchanged
scope: saved-policy intervention on known trajectories only; no new Holdem training, selected suffix or fallback deployment, remedy/default/fresh/global admission or general convergence/playing-strength claim; an effect of filling unlearned rows does not uniquely identify the training cause
